ruling.recommended_action: Close the dispute with no refund: the $7.81 excess distance billed stands, because the off-route segment's 4.97 km are exempt under the rider's own prior general route consent and what remains (0.57 km) is within RD-1's 1 km tolerance. No account flag (RD-6 unavailable on F17: 0 upheld route deviations in 90 days). Send the rider a short note explaining the exemption and the tolerance, and mark the trace's RD-4 ground (a traffic reason on record) in the case file.
ruling.reasoning:
Deviation is measured, not disputed: actual 30.0 km against optimal 24.4 km, +5.6 km (+23%), with one off-route segment 18:48-18:59 that drove 7.35 km where the optimal route covers 2.38 km, adding 4.97 km [F1][F3][RD-1]. The trace's RD-1 check passes on the billed-minus-optimal deviation of 5.54 km, so RD-2's refund matrix is engaged [F4][RD-2].

The amount turns entirely on whether that segment is exempt under RD-5 [F3][RD-5]. A rider message preceded the segment: the driver asked at 18:45 "Jam ahead, shall I take another way?" [F7], and the rider answered at 18:46 "可以，不要走 Clementi Avenue 2" — a yes that leaves the alternative way to the driver and rules out one road [F8][F7]. The segment began at 18:48, so the agreement came before it [F3][F8].

No road to be taken was named, so this is not an agreement to a named road; it is a general route choice under RD-5 [F8][F7][RD-5]. Both advocates read F3 on that ground (general_route_consent, exempt) and I adopt the shared reading: the one express condition was honoured, since Clementi Avenue 2 appears nowhere among the roads driven (Clementi West Street 1, West Coast Road, Clementi Road, Kent Ridge Crescent, Kent Ridge Drive, Arts Link, Computing Drive, Heng Mui Keng Terrace, Pasir Panjang Road, South Buona Vista Road) [F3][F8][RD-5]. The driver's post-trip statement says the same, but a driver's statement never supplies consent; consent rests on the rider's timestamped F8 [F10][F8][RD-5]. I note my reservation that the loop is far longer than the stretch it replaced, but the record names no route the parties agreed, so I do not substitute my own scope reading for the shared one [F3][F8][RD-5].

With the segment exempt, the arithmetic follows the trace: (5.54 km deviation - 4.97 km exempt) = 0.57 km, times $1.4099/km = $0.80, which is within RD-1's 1 km tolerance, so no refund is due: no_action [F4][F1][F3][RD-2][RD-1].

Nothing else adds to or reduces the amount. F11's band-2 congestion on the Ayer Rajah Expressway and F14's absence of incidents speak only to RD-4's violation line — the trace's RD-4 line means no violation is logged on traffic grounds, and a traffic reason never exempts or refunds under RD-2 [F11][F14][RD-4][RD-2]. The 1.0x surge produces no differential [F5][SURGE-3]. No account flag: the trace's RD-6 check fails on F17's 0 upheld route deviations in 90 days [F17][RD-6].

The agreement covers this segment, so its km are exempt and the remaining 0.57 km falls within RD-1's tolerance.

Consent does not rest on F10 at all: it rests on the rider's own timestamped message F8, sent before the segment [F8][F3][RD-5].

F11's band-2 congestion and F14's absence of incidents go only to RD-4's violation line; a traffic reason neither exempts nor refunds under RD-2, and the amount here turns on the agreement in F8 [F11][F14][F8][RD-4][RD-2].

The $7.81 excess distance figure is the record's arithmetic (F4), but RD-2 deducts exempt km before refunding, and F3's km are exempt under F8, leaving 0.57 km within tolerance [F4][F3][F8][RD-2][RD-1].
Withdrawn by the rider and unavailable in any event: F17 shows 0 upheld route deviations in 90 days, so RD-6's repeat-breach flag does not attach [F17][RD-6].
The rider's clean profile (F16) decides nothing; profile facts are never the finding, and consent here turns on the chat in F7 and F8 [F16][F7][F8][RD-6].

The driver's conclusion of no_action follows from the shared reading of F3 as exempt, but his further claim that no violation is recorded on these facts is not borne out: the trace's RD-4 line settles only the traffic ground, and the RD-2 violation entry is a separate record [F3][F11][F17][RD-2][RD-4][RD-6].
